_doc: Influence, rank points, the status ladder and leaders (GDD §3 'outstanding citizen', §11, §12; docs/CITIZENS_1_6.md §2). Influence a survivor earns goes to the base pool AND to their own rank points; spending from the pool never lowers anyone's rank, and status is never lost. Rates and thresholds are Claude's.

influence.note: GDD: every action gives influence (days in the base, missions done, morale, zombie kills; kill-chain score after a horde night). Well Liked (influence) scales it

ladder.note: GDD: not under the player's control, may steal
community skill works base-wide at half strength (CITIZENS_1_6 §6); can be made leader
